title: Reconciling Household and Payroll Employment
units: Thousands; level is Oct 2026; level and 12-month change not seasonally adjusted
source: Bureau of Labor Statistics; author’s calculations.
note: BLS’s adjustment of the household survey to payroll-survey definitions, rebuilt from its published components; the items subtracted carry a reversed sign so every column adds down. BLS seasonally adjusts household employment, agriculture, the self-employed and the payroll-concept total but not the other four items, so in the 1-month column those four share one row: the adjusted total less the adjusted rows above it. Changes that run through a January include that month’s population-control revision. 13-month change through Oct 2026: the household survey was not collected for Oct 2025, so no 12-month change exists for that month.
